messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Tenaris
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Varela,

Following my earlier introduction, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Tenaris's international growth, Middle East exposure, local industrial value and corporate affairs priorities.

The paper addresses government and institutional alignment, workforce and localization, supply-chain resilience, and decarbonization evidence. These areas closely match my operating experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and regulated stakeholder execution.

My executive CV is included in the final three pages. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding leadership needs across corporate affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy, local value, sustainability or country-facing execution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Tenaris
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Tenaris combines a global manufacturing footprint, strong liquidity and exposure to major energy markets at a time when logistics disruption, tariffs, local-content expectations and industrial decarbonization are reshaping operating priorities. Second-quarter 2026 results showed continued cash generation alongside pressure from Middle East shipping disruption and higher costs. The company also continues leadership transition, sustainability commitments and growth across energy markets including Guyana, Suriname and the Middle East. My director-level experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and local-value execution would support Tenaris by strengthening institutional alignment and converting external commitments into measurable cross-functional delivery.
strategic_brief.company_context: Tenaris reported second-quarter 2026 net sales of approximately $2.967 billion, EBITDA of $649 million and a net cash position of $3.6 billion. The quarter reflected lower shipments to parts of the Middle East during disruption around the Strait of Hormuz, while sales increased in Guyana, Suriname and Venezuela and deliveries began for the Sakarya Black Sea development. Tenaris also maintains a 2030 target to reduce carbon dioxide intensity per ton of steel by 30 percent and has continued updating leadership and governance structures during 2026. Across Saudi Arabia and wider international markets, these priorities create a substantial corporate-affairs agenda around localization, workforce, government engagement, supply resilience, industrial policy and sustainability evidence.

opportunities.title: Government and institutional alignment
opportunities.rationale: Tenaris operates across markets where national energy strategy, industrial policy, customs, localization requirements and state-linked customers influence business conditions. Structured institutional engagement can improve visibility of external dependencies and connect country relationships with commercial and operational priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish country stakeholder maps connecting ministries, regulators, investment agencies, national companies and internal owners, supported by issue registers and executive escalation so external developments translate into clear actions and decisions.

opportunities.title: Workforce and localization delivery
opportunities.rationale: Saudi Arabia and other strategic markets place significant emphasis on local employment, skills development, supplier participation and domestic industrial capability. Credible delivery requires measurable commitments and strong coordination across HR, procurement, operations, corporate affairs and leadership.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would translate localization objectives into measurable workforce and supplier plans with named owners, evidence requirements and executive reporting, drawing on direct experience managing local participation and stakeholder commitments in a multinational resource environment.

opportunities.title: Supply-chain resilience governance
opportunities.rationale: Recent Middle East shipping disruption and tariff costs demonstrate how external events can quickly affect logistics, margins and customer delivery. A coordinated country and stakeholder risk model can help leadership identify emerging dependencies earlier and align operational responses across functions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would create a concise external-risk dashboard linking logistics, government measures, customs, suppliers and customer commitments with accountable owners and escalation thresholds, strengthening cross-functional response before disruptions materially affect delivery.

opportunities.title: Decarbonization evidence and positioning
opportunities.rationale: Tenaris has a defined 2030 carbon-intensity target and operates energy-intensive steel and manufacturing assets. Governments, customers and investors increasingly expect environmental commitments to be supported by traceable operating evidence, clear accountability and credible progress reporting.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen evidence ownership and cross-functional governance for material sustainability commitments, drawing on practical experience with carbon-data traceability, environmental-management systems, renewable-energy positioning and executive stakeholder reporting.

days_0_30: Map priority institutions, customers, localization requirements and external dependencies.
Review material workforce, supplier and sustainability commitments.
Identify external issues with direct delivery, cost or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align corporate affairs, HR, procurement, operations and sustainability engagement plans.
Create a consolidated issue and commitment register with named owners.
Define executive indicators for localization, stakeholder risk and sustainability delivery.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on priority government, logistics and industrial-policy issues.
Embed monthly cross-functional review of country risks and commitments.
Strengthen evidence controls for local-value and decarbonization claims.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority international markets.
Measure issue closure and commitment performance.
Codify lessons into a repeatable corporate-affairs and country stakeholder playbook.

potential_impact: Earlier identification and resolution of government and logistics issues.
Stronger localization and workforce delivery in strategic markets.
Improved executive visibility across external risks and commitments.
More credible evidence behind decarbonization and sustainability positioning.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in multinational mining.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, contractors and communities around strategic projects and operating commitments.
Experience coordinating external obligations across HR, procurement, operations, environment, finance, legal and leadership teams.
Practical work on local participation, carbon-data traceability and environmental-management systems.
